summary_en: TAIHO KOGYO executed a share buyback of 1.65 million shares (5.8% of outstanding shares) at 1,082 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 29, 2026, with a total budget of 2 billion yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock Through Off-Hours Matching System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, TAIHO KOGYO's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.65 million shares of common stock, representing 5.8% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, with a budget ceiling of 2 billion yen. The company executed the purchase via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours matching system on October 29, 2026, at the closing price of 1,082 yen per share from October 28.

The buyback was implemented through an off-hours trading order placed at 8:45 a.m. on October 29, 2026, as a single-time order valid only for that trading session. The execution results were to be announced after the conclusion of trading at 8:45 a.m. that day. The company stated that market conditions could result in partial or no execution of the planned purchase.

TAIHO KOGYO's stated rationale for the buyback was to pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environments while enhancing capital efficiency and shareholder returns. The operation was authorized under Article 156 of the Companies Act, as applied through Article 165(3).
